# Counts ONLY: cases live in the untrusted target, so no title/path/id/snippet reaches run_manifest

#: Cap so a hostile pre-seeded ``security-remediation/`` cannot make us read a gigabyte
# Cumulative across repos (cf util.counters.snapshot_cumulative): ONE manifest per batch invocation
# Deliberately narrow AND-gate (else `|| true`); MergeReadiness is operator's call; no disk read
# ``{}`` not zeros when nothing parsed; deliberately NOT for exit codes: counts cases ON DISK
# Best-effort reader (same tree discover_cases guards): warn and skip, never raise.

# is_file() stats without opening: a planted device node/FIFO is skipped, not blocked on
# An unvalidated attempt contributes to `states` but to no decision.

# Catches all on purpose: no case file may fail a finished tally (e.g. derive.py drift)
